issues.failure_explanation: The appendix purports to prove exactness of the augmented horizontal complex, but its last step assumes $\ker(\mcI^{\vartriangle})=\operatorname{im}(\dDh)$ on $\Omega^{p,l}$ via \eqref{eq:ii}. In the difference setting that identity was introduced only after assuming the very exactness being proved. The displayed horizontal homotopy identity is stated for $1\le k\le p$ and for $k=0$ by adjoining $\Omega^{-1,l}=0$; it therefore covers exactness through the map $\Omega^{p-1,l}\to\Omega^{p,l}$, not the required final statement that a horizontally closed $(p,l)$-form lies in $\operatorname{im}(\dDh)$. A necessary top-degree Poincar\'e step is missing and the appeal to \eqref{eq:ii} is circular.

failure_location.quote: First of all, notice that $\ker (\mcI^{\vartriangle})=\operatorname{im} (\dDh)$, which is an immediate consequence of \eqref{eq:ii}.

issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: No complete source-supported repair identified; at minimum, a repair must prove $\ker(\mcI^{\vartriangle})=\operatorname{im}(\dDh)$ on $\Omega^{p,l}$ for every $l\ge1$ independently of \eqref{eq:ii}, e.g. by a top-degree difference Poincar\'e lemma or an additional homotopy operator for $k=p$.
issues.overall_effect: The exactness of the augmented difference variational bicomplex is not established by the Appendix as written. The boundary-complex exactness proof in thm:added-4, and uses of the difference analogue of \eqref{eq:ii} for $l\ge1$ such as the coordinate-free Noether derivation, lose their stated foundation unless the final horizontal exactness step is proved independently.
issues.title: Circular gap in the proof of horizontal exactness at the top degree
issues.why_classification: The gap is not a local sign or quantifier fix: the supplied homotopy operators stop before the top horizontal degree, and the missing step is the difference analogue of the Poincar\'e lemma on which the augmented bicomplex and the boundary exactness claim rest. A repair requires a new nontrivial argument, so no comparable version of the proof survives as written.
